scope: Compact Weber find-verify-fix audit method packet adapted from the SGA5 live source-audit workflow. This belongs on the workflow/replication record, not as a promoted Weber reader.

workflow_lessons: The SGA5 page-local find -> verify -> fix pattern transfers to Weber German transcription, but Weber immediate priority is omission/summarization detection in the German branch, not English translation.
The current Weber German TeX is a half-baked GPT draft and must be audited for missing lines, compressed prose, and missing formulae before fine symbol forensics.

The logged Weber passes now cover p100-p311. They restored determinant/proof/formula material, theorem numerals, source equation tags, sign-schema labels, roots-of-unity symbols, xrefs, single-symbol Greek/Latin variable confusions, dense convergence-proof notation, dropped equations, Newton footnote material, symmetric-function displays, small prose omissions, tuple entries, a p154 sign error, p160-p161 prose omissions, p172 dropped equation, p175 ratio-chain content, p178 section divider, p179 coefficient-index order, p188 prose omission, p195 identity reconstruction, p198 dropped Q^tau/display material, p203 discriminant exponent, p204-p221 dense invariant/Hermite/Tschirnhausen repairs, p222-p257 Cardano/Bezoutiante/Sturm repairs, p258-p287 quadratic-form/Hermite/discriminant determinant repairs, and p288-p299 characteristic-theory/fundamental-theorem repairs, p300-p305 Budan-Fourier/Newton repairs including two restored sign tables, and p306-p311 Newton/Descartes/Jacobi criteria repairs including a restored double-row table and dropped formula material while preserving 357-360 page/0-error compile gates.
The p210-p215 section shows a structural-hold pattern: when per-line agent grafts make a broken hybrid, hold the region for whole-section reconstruction rather than applying plausible local edits.

The p240-p245 pass caught the first clear over-expansion where TeX added a full product that Weber printed only as a prototype factor; the workflow must detect both omissions and over-added editorial completions.
The p264-p269 pass found another TeX escape-corruption class where a Greek macro was split at line wrap; a follow-up grep for line-ending broken macros should be part of later passes.
The p282-p287 pass added a page by restoring a dropped determinant-decomposition block, reinforcing the page-count compile gate as a swallow/expansion signal rather than a mere build check.

Verifier quality is inconsistent: it rejected all four p105 phantom proposals in one batch but accepted false candidates in later batches, including p132-p137 double-bar inequality escalation, p155 source-oversight reversion, p158 resultant-degree source-error reversion, and p162 end-variable source-typo reversion. The foreground source-eye and mathematical-context check remains the real gate.
The same workflow can produce hallucinated fixes on phantom/no-scan pages, proving again that agent output must be treated as finder evidence and never applied without source-image verification.

The current dominant Weber Volume I error patterns are single-glyph mathematical misreading, occasional dropped displays/terms, and occasional source-typo/editorial traps. They are often cheap for agents to find and easy to eye-verify, but mathematically material.

Local source measurement found no native >=650dpi Weber scan on disk: Band I and III are about 500dpi and Band II about 560dpi, so tight crops and explicit uncertainty flags are required for hard symbols.

The workflow separates type A source deviations from type B source typos and cosmetic differences. Do not revert clear editorial corrections of source typos unless the project deliberately chooses a diplomatic edition mode.
Every accepted fix still requires foreground/human review before application; the agent output is patch-ready evidence, not authority.

One workflow at a time is safer than many concurrent workflows because the limiting factor observed in SGA5/Weber lanes is server/tool reliability, rate limiting, and review load rather than local CPU/GPU.
The packet deliberately excludes bulky rendered source chunks; those should be generated on demand from the manifest.
caveats: This package does not certify Weber and should not be attached to the Weber author record as a reader replacement.
The included audit manifest is a control/harness layer; it is not a proof that all pages have been audited.
